title: AX56 Chat
profTagline: Off-grid chat over raw Wi-Fi — no internet, no router, just the RTL8852AU and whoever is in range
installDesc: Add to your home screen to chat off-grid, full-screen.
installIosHint: Tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
installGenericHint: Open the browser menu and choose Install.
joinBody: Pick a room name and a passphrase. Everyone who enters the same pair shares one encrypted room — messages ride the air in beacons, so only holders of the passphrase can read them.
noUsb: No USB access here. Install the app, or open in desktop Chrome.
demoNote: Demo conversation — connect an adapter to talk for real
nearbyEmpty: Listening — nothing on the air yet
nearbyDemo: Demo scan — connect an adapter to see who's really nearby
engChNote: Switching channel needs a cold replug of the adapter.
engOffHint: Join a room or open Nearby to bring the adapter up.
